title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request deletion of your biometric data from facial recognition systems. Protect your privacy with our ready-to-use letter.
description: A comprehensive letter template to request removal of your biometric data from facial recognition databases, retail stores, and surveillance systems. Includes legal references and step-by-step guidance for protecting your facial recognition privacy rights.

sections.heading: Subject and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Deletion of Biometric Data and Facial Recognition Information

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request the deletion of all biometric data, facial recognition information, and related personal identifiers that your organization may have collected, stored, or processed about me. This request is made pursuant to applicable privacy laws including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other relevant state and federal regulations.

sections.heading: Identification and Scope of Request
sections.content:
Please consider this a formal request to:

1. Delete all facial recognition data, biometric identifiers, and biometric templates associated with my identity
2. Remove any photographs, video recordings, or images used for facial recognition analysis
3. Cease any ongoing collection or processing of my biometric information
4. Provide confirmation that all requested data has been permanently deleted from your systems and any third-party vendors

The personal information subject to this request includes but is not limited to:
- Facial geometry measurements and templates
- Biometric identifiers derived from photographs or video
- Any metadata associated with biometric processing
- Records of my presence detected through facial recognition systems

placeholders.label: Additional identifying information (optional)
placeholders.defaultValue: Customer account number, visit dates, or store locations if applicable

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Rights
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights as provided by:

- The Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (740 ILCS 14/), which requires informed consent for biometric data collection
- The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), which grants consumers the right to delete personal information
- The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), if applicable to international data processing
- Other applicable state biometric privacy laws and consumer protection regulations

I did not provide informed written consent for the collection or storage of my biometric information, and I hereby revoke any consent that may have been implied through my presence in your establishment or use of your services.

sections.heading: Response Requirements
sections.content:
Please provide a written response within 30 days confirming:

1. Whether your organization has collected, stored, or processed my biometric data
2. The specific types of biometric information that were collected
3. The purposes for which this information was used
4. Confirmation that all requested data has been permanently deleted
5. Details about any third parties with whom my biometric data was shared
6. Steps taken to ensure complete removal from all systems and backups

If you are unable to fulfill this request, please provide a detailed explanation of the legal basis for retaining my biometric information.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
Please send your response to the address listed above or via email at [Your Email]. I expect this matter to be handled promptly and in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact me at [Your Phone Number]. I reserve all rights under applicable law, including the right to pursue legal remedies if this request is not handled appropriately.

Thank you for your immediate attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
